painPoints.title: The familiar worries behind every month's power bill
painPoints.description: If you're facing any of the issues below, it's time to take control of the power supply for your home or business.

items.title: Power bills spike every hot season
items.description: Residential electricity is billed on a tiered scale - the more you use, the more expensive each kWh gets. Run the AC all summer and your bill can jump 2-3x compared to a normal month.

items.title: Outages and voltage drops disrupt life and production
items.description: Sudden power loss spoils goods in cold storage and halts production lines, causing losses that could have been avoided.

items.title: Worried about unreliable installers
items.description: Sloppy installation causes roof leaks, unbranded equipment of unknown origin, and vague warranty promises - reasons many households and businesses hesitate to invest.

items.title: Metal roofs trap heat, making living spaces stifling
items.description: Roofs and warehouses absorb heavy heat during the day, making the space below hot and driving up cooling costs.

painPoints.bannerHighlight: take control of your power supply
painPoints.bannerSuffix: turning your monthly electricity cost into a profitable investment.

whySolar.title: Rooftop solar - a profitable investment, not just a cost
whySolar.description: This isn't just a trend - it's a smart financial solution that lets you control your electricity costs for the long term.

items.title: Significant savings on electricity
items.description: Cut up to 80-90% off your monthly power bill, with payback in just 4-6 years while the system runs for over 25 years.

items.title: A power supply you control, with peace of mind
items.description: Combined with battery storage, keep essential appliances running even during grid outages or rolling blackouts.

items.title: Increased property value
items.description: Homes and factories with solar systems are valued higher when sold or leased thanks to lower operating costs and a modern image.

items.title: Contributing to environmental protection
items.description: Use clean energy, reduce CO2 emissions, and meet the ESG standards increasingly valued by international partners and customers.

scenarios.title: From homes to farms - there's a solution for every setting
scenarios.description: Whether you're a household, a small business, or a working farm, PNG ONE SOLAR has an installation plan that fits your roof size and budget.

story.title: From a small technical team to a leading EPC contractor
story.p1: PNG ONE SOLAR was founded by a team of electrical engineers with years of experience in renewable energy. Starting from a desire to ease the electricity cost burden on Vietnamese households, we have continuously expanded our capabilities to serve large-scale industrial projects as well.
story.p2: Today, PNG ONE SOLAR is proud to be the trusted partner of thousands of customers, thanks to a transparent process, a professional installation team, and clear, long-term warranty policies.

tariff.label: Monthly electricity tariff

phase.label: Power supply

daytime.label: Share of usage between 6am and 6pm

offset.label: Desired level of energy independence
offset.note: The share of your monthly power needs you'd like solar output to cover.
